dragunov-detail112.author: Tabasco / LonesomeDucky / ZONE derivative
dragunov-detail112.materialLineage: Tabasco CC0 Dragunov silhouette and measured grip retained. ZONE adds bevelled receiver and optic collars, clamps, lens surfaces, controls, fasteners, vents and magazine detail. Retained LonesomeDucky CC0 bat wood color/normal maps preserve the original worn grain and projected UVs, with new nonmetallic roughness. ZONE supplies original procedural worn-steel and rubber PBR maps.
dragunov-detail112.identityNote: Visual-only fictional gameplay sniper representation. The source optic is retained and detailed; opaque coated-lens approximation, no through-scope or functional firearm claim.
